items.title: Bladeless Robotic Laser Surgery
items.shortDescription: Bladeless LASIK and bladeless cataract care designed for precision, safety and faster recovery.
longDescription: Aakash Eye Hospital highlights bladeless robotic laser surgery for perfect vision, highest safety, faster recovery and 100% precision.
The service includes bladeless LASIK and bladeless cataract pathways supported by modern diagnostic planning.
featureBullets: Bladeless LASIK and bladeless cataract options
Precision-focused treatment planning
Faster recovery and patient safety emphasis
Advanced technology-led workflow

faq.question: Is bladeless laser surgery available for every patient?
faq.answer: Suitability depends on eye health, corneal measurements and the doctor's examination. The team confirms eligibility after diagnostics.

faq.question: Which branch should I contact for laser surgery?
faq.answer: LASIK numbers are listed for Visnagar and Ahmedabad. Bharuch patients can contact the local branch for guidance.

items.title: Phaco Cataract Surgery
items.shortDescription: Modern cataract removal with phacoemulsification and intraocular lens implantation.
longDescription: Cataract is the clouding of the natural crystalline lens, commonly associated with ageing. Surgery is the only known effective treatment for cataract removal.

At Aakash Eye Hospital, cataract surgery is focused on removing the cloudy natural lens and replacing it with an intraocular lens. Phacoemulsification with IOL implantation is the core technique used at the center.
items.imageAlt: Aakash Eye Hospital facility for cataract care
featureBullets: Phaco cataract surgery available since 1995
Outpatient day-care approach for suitable cases
IOL power calculation support with advanced diagnostics
Options may include monofocal, toric and multifocal IOLs after consultation

faq.question: Does cataract surgery require admission?
faq.answer: Legacy content describes cataract surgery as an outpatient day-care procedure for suitable cases, usually with a short hospital stay.

faq.question: Can normal activity resume after surgery?
faq.answer: Post-operative activity depends on the doctor's advice. The legacy content states that many patients resume normal work quickly while continuing eye drops.

items.title: LASIK / Excimer
items.shortDescription: Laser vision correction for reducing dependence on glasses or contact lenses.
longDescription: LASIK is a surgical procedure for permanent removal or reduction of dependence on glasses and contact lenses.
The legacy site describes the I Look Laser Vision Center at Aakash Eye Hospital as equipped with VISX STAR S4 IR technology, Wavescan aberrometer, pachymeter and topography support.
items.imageAlt: Close-up eye visual for laser vision correction
featureBullets: Excimer laser added in 2009
Wavefront-guided diagnostic planning described by the legacy site
Outpatient workflow for suitable laser cases
ICL and refractive lens exchange may be discussed for higher refractive errors

faq.question: Can both eyes be treated together?
faq.answer: The legacy LASIK content states that both eyes are commonly treated at the same time for suitable candidates.

faq.question: What if LASIK is not suitable?
faq.answer: The doctor may discuss alternatives such as ICL or refractive lens exchange depending on eye measurements and refractive error.

faq.question: What tests are used for retina care?

faq.question: Do all retina visits require imaging?
faq.answer: Imaging depends on the eye examination and the doctor's treatment plan.

items.title: Glaucoma Care
items.shortDescription: Evaluation and treatment planning for glaucoma, with a mission to prevent avoidable blindness.
longDescription: Glaucoma is a disease where pressure inside the eye can damage the nerve fibers forming the optic nerve.
Aakash Eye Hospital's legacy glaucoma content describes detailed investigation with applanation tonometry, perimetry, GCC and RNFL analysis with OCT, optic disc photography and fundus camera support.
items.imageAlt: Diagnostic care area for glaucoma evaluation
featureBullets: Pressure and optic nerve evaluation
Perimetry and OCT-supported analysis
Family history and high-risk screening guidance
Surgical care pathways when advised by the specialist

faq.question: Who is at higher risk of glaucoma?
faq.answer: The legacy content lists family history, high myopia, high blood pressure, diabetes, long-term steroid use and past eye injuries as risk factors.

faq.question: Can glaucoma be silent?
faq.answer: Yes. The legacy content calls glaucoma a silent blinding disease, so routine evaluation matters for high-risk patients.

items.title: General Ophthalmology / OPD
items.shortDescription: Everyday eye care, refraction, follow-ups and specialist referral pathways.
longDescription: The OPD pathway helps patients start with a complete eye evaluation and move into the right service when more specialized care is needed.
Aakash Eye Hospital also supports pediatric eye problems including pediatric cataract, pediatric squint, amblyopia management, allergic conjunctivitis and refraction in young children.
items.imageAlt: Ophthalmology eye examination for OPD care
featureBullets: Routine eye examination and refraction
Follow-up care for old cases
Pediatric ophthalmology support
Referral into cataract, retina, glaucoma and laser services

faq.question: Should old patients bring their previous file?
faq.answer: Yes. The hospital promise asks old-case patients to bring the previous case file because old case files have no due date.

faq.question: Can I choose a branch before booking?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment form lets you select Visnagar, Ahmedabad or Bharuch.
